name: Valagamba
wd_description: king of the Anuradhapura Kingdom of Sri Lanka
extract: Valagamba (Sinhala: වට්ඨ ගාමණී අභය, වලගම්බා), also known (in Pāli) as Vaṭṭagāmiṇi Abhaya and Valagam Abha. Valagamba was a king of the Anuradhapura Kingdom of Sri Lanka. Five months after becoming king, he was overthrown by a rebellion and an invasion from South India, but regained the throne by defeating the invaders fourteen years later. He is also known for the construction of the Abhayagiri Dagaba and Aluthepola Ganekanda Raja Maha Vihara.
